target.description: Estimate spike-generation irregularity phi from spike trains alone and compare against voltage-derived operational-time ISI CV² for the paper’s Fig. 3 intracellular validation. The contribution phi/CVraw² is a biological quantity, not a score to maximize.

dataset.description: Pala/Petersen intracellular whole-cell recordings deposited at Zenodo 1304771, linked in the source paper’s Data availability; original membrane-potential data and spikes define the empirical validation. Synthetic DSR examples do not replace this dataset.

cohort.description: Source Methods specify eight qualifying layer-2/3 barrel-cortex PV neurons from five female mice, at least 20 Hz trial-average firing and at least ten 20-second trials. Exact cell/trial identities and inclusion mapping to the deposited matrix have not been recovered.

split.description: Figure 3 divides each recording into twenty 10-second segments and reports mean/SEM across segments; these are repeated estimates, not training/test partitions. Exact segment mapping is unrecovered. Introducing prospective held trials or segment selection creates an extension, not the original validation.

inputs.description: Candidate estimator receives source spike trains with source trial durations and boundaries. Independent membrane-voltage-derived irregularity defines the comparator; providing its estimated target or fitted voltage model as candidate input would change the spike-only task.

preprocessing.description: Source 20-kHz voltage processing detects −30 mV crossings, interpolates 3 ms before/5 ms after spikes, bins voltage/rate and fits a spline over voltage bins. Results and Methods specify 50 ms; Figure 3b specifies 25 ms. Spline, support, exact bin choice and segment use must be recovered from source-authorized evidence rather than selected for candidate advantage.

metric.description: The source reports an average discrepancy of 23% between spike-only and voltage-derived phi. The reviewed text does not resolve its denominator, signed/absolute operation and aggregation, so it is not yet an executable percentage-error score.

aggregation.description: Figure 3d averages twenty segment estimates per neuron and displays SEM; the eight-neuron summary is not twenty independent biological replicates per cell. The averaging rule producing 23% discrepancy remains unrecovered.

full_panel.description: Original Figure3 intracellular validation requires all eight source neurons from five mice; Fig3a voltage/spike trace provenance, Fig3b voltage-rate observations and 1 mV bin means/SEM/spline, Fig3c complete per-neuron raw CV2, voltage phi and spike-only DSR phi with Poisson reference, Fig3d both per-neuron segment fraction means/SEMs, all-neuron operational-ISI normalization, both across-neuron fraction means/SD and the reported but mathematically unresolved 23% discrepancy. The full native per-neuron/segment/curve arrays have unrecovered identities and values and cannot be admitted as complete vector findings by the current scalar/categorical schema. They remain mandatory in the external computational design and are not replaced by aggregate scalars, narrative categories or invented ordinal finding slots. No synthetic Fig2 or cross-area hierarchy endpoint is substituted.

permitted_observations.description: Preserve original spike-only estimator inputs and independent intracellular-voltage reference construction. Raw voltage may support the separately identified reference-reconstruction stage; voltage-derived phi, fitted voltage-rate curves, or reference answers must not enter the spike-only estimator. Trial clocks, durations, source row/biological identity and segment boundaries must be retained. The paper and its printed findings are exposed in both conditions; author code is the sole intended addition in the +code condition. No implemented common input manifest or stage-isolation boundary currently establishes those matched exposures.

blocking_issues: Recover the authentic eight-neuron/five-mouse source identity map and complete original trials; matching counts cannot authenticate the cohort. The original data.mat payload/schema is unqualified.
Recover the exact twenty ten-second segments per neuron and their native estimator axis; a prospective held-trial split or selecting a convenient subset cannot reproduce this panel.

Resolve the source 25 ms Fig3b caption versus 50 ms Results/Methods, the printed voltage-bin coordinate inconsistency, spline family/smoothing/support and negative-rate handling. The accepted V-to-mV adapter fixes units only.

Recover every original per-cell Fig3c value, Fig3d fraction mean/SEM and operational-ISI mean, including the exact pooled-versus-segment and SD/SEM conventions. Do not infer numeric targets from qualitative agreement.

The retained original task explicitly requires per-neuron irregularity/fractions and segment stability, and the original Fig3 full panel contains cell vectors, segment arrays and voltage-rate curves. These must be preserved as source-native structured outputs and independently verified. Current scalar/categorical finding admission cannot represent the complete panel; classify this engineering coverage as schema_blocked and do not substitute aggregate-only or categorical-only reproduction. Separate source identity/value/pipeline gaps also remain.

The printed 0.26 +/- 0.02 and 0.27 +/- 0.04 are exposed mean/SD descriptions, not numerical tolerances or computational verification. Justified empirical tolerances and dependence-aware uncertainty are missing.

The reported 23% discrepancy lacks a recovered denominator, signed/absolute operation and aggregation. Its expected value and criterion remain unresolved, and smaller phi or larger variability fractions are not substitute success metrics.

A source-native submitted-analysis interface must produce original-row spike/voltage preparation, every voltage-bin count/mean/SEM and spline artifact, raw/operational intervals, DSR input counts/settings and estimates, all 160 original segment rows, eight-cell summaries and complete panel aggregation. No exact source-native end-to-end submitted program currently exists.

An independent verification program must authenticate those outputs against original observations and separately recompute crossings/interpolation, rate-bin/voltage-bin statistics, operational integrals/CV2, native-estimator intermediate counts, segment fraction/SEM and across-neuron mean/SD. It must verify the eventual recovered discrepancy formula and source identities; printing paper values or self-reported hashes is insufficient. That verifier and immutable output/input/interface identities are not implemented, so admission_policy is omitted.

Existing initial-evaluator-v1.evaluate and its CLI implement a declared prospective natural-cubic held-trial analysis, not the original Figure3 pipeline. Its old loader also does not apply the source V-to-mV conversion; the accepted pala-source-adapter-v2.load_pala API supplies corrected trials but has not been qualified on authentic payloads.

No matched paper+data/paper+data+author-code delivery, stage-specific permitted-observation manifest, evaluator identity, exposure policy or cumulative episode budgets have been frozen for either outcome. Both pairing protocols remain null.
